coreMemory.chinese: 死亡；死去；消失；逐渐减弱；停止运转；没电
coreMemory.english: v. to stop living；v. to gradually disappear or become weaker；v. to stop functioning because power or energy is gone
coreMemory.structure: die of something /ˈdaɪ ˈʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（死于疾病或内因）；die from something /ˈdaɪ ˈfrʌm ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（死于外部原因）；die out /ˈdaɪ ˈaʊt/（灭绝；消失）；die down /ˈdaɪ ˈdaʊn/（逐渐平息）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ be dying to does something → ✅ be dying to do something；❌ die for something → ✅ die of something

commonErrors.note: 在“be dying to do something”中，这个 to 是不定式标记，后面必须接动词原形。do 只是语法占位符，真实表达要把它换成 finish、check 等符合语境的动词原形。
在“die of something”所表达的这个具体含义中，要用介词 of；换成 for 会破坏这个固定结构或改变原意。

meanings.english: to gradually disappear or become weaker

meanings.translation: 一些地方表达会逐渐消失。

meanings.english: to stop functioning because power or energy is gone
meanings.example: My phone died before I could call her.
meanings.translation: 我还没来得及给她打电话，手机就没电了。

fixedPhrases.example: Many people still die of preventable diseases.

fixedPhrases.example: Some local expressions die out over time.

fixedPhrases.example: Sounds often die away as you move farther from the road.
fixedPhrases.translation: 离公路越远，声音往往越微弱。

fixedPhrases.example: I am dying to know the result.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我非常想知道结果。

coreMemory.chinese: 生长；长大；增长；扩大；逐渐变得
coreMemory.english: v. to become larger or develop naturally；v. to increase in size, number, or importance；v. to gradually become a particular state
coreMemory.structure: grow quickly /ˈɡroʊ ˈkwɪkliː/（快速增长或成长）；grow into something /ˈɡroʊ ˈɪntuː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（成长为；发展成某物）；grow up /ˈɡroʊ ˈʌp/（长大）；grow tired of something /ˈɡroʊ ˈtaɪɚd ˈʌv ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（逐渐厌倦某事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ grow at something → ✅ grow into something；❌ grow tired for something → ✅ grow tired of something

commonErrors.note: 在“grow into something”所表达的这个具体含义中，要用介词 into；换成 at 会破坏这个固定结构或改变原意。
在“grow tired of something”所表达的这个具体含义中，要用介词 of；换成 for 会破坏这个固定结构或改变原意。

meanings.english: to become larger or develop naturally
meanings.example: These plants grow quickly in warm weather.

fixedPhrases.example: You will grow in confidence as you speak more often.
fixedPhrases.translation: 随着开口次数增加，你会越来越自信。

fixedPhrases.example: We grow tomatoes from seed every spring.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们每年春天用种子种番茄。

synonyms.difference: develop 更侧重“发展；成长”；grow 的核心义是“生长”。两者意思接近，但替换时仍要核对宾语、介词和具体语境。

antonyms.usage: 当 grow 表示“生长”时，shrink 表示“缩小；减少”。两者只在这个明确义项下构成直接对比，其他用法不能一概互换。

derivatives.note: 可指身体、经济或能力增长。

confusables.difference: raise 表示“上升；高地；增高”；grow 在本卡核心搭配“grow quickly”中表示“生长”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
